name: android_devices
description: Read the configured LAN screen-sharing App's device identity and list available ESP32 serial ports. Does not open a serial port or scan the network.

name: android_screenshot
description: Read a fresh original-resolution JPEG from the installed device screen-sharing App at its configured LAN address. Returns an MCP image and this session's frameId. The phone must have granted screen-sharing permission.

deviceSerial.description: Exact screen App device UUID; when provided it must match the configured endpoint's phone.

name: android_preview_tap
description: Preview a proposed tap without moving or clicking the real mouse. Returns a fresh original-resolution phone image with a clearly labeled SIMULATED TARGET marker and a 2x local zoom. Verify the intended UI target visually before using returned tapArguments. No ARM or calibration is needed. This checks the coordinate choice, not physical mouse calibration; use android_control hover to inspect the real cursor before click if needed.

frameId.description: frameId from this MCP session's latest android_screenshot, android_preview_tap, android_control or calibration probe result of this exact phone, less than 30 seconds old.

name: android_control
description: Preferred observe-act-observe tool: use this session's screenshot frameId, send one ESP32 BLE action, and return a new phone image captured after the action completed. Prepares input automatically; the physical emergency stop always wins. move/click/scroll/key/type/home/back need no pointer calibration. Preview target selection with android_preview_tap; hover moves the calibrated mouse without pressing, then click only after inspecting its actual cursor. tap/hover/swipe retain explicit measured calibration and estimated coordinates. Never repeat an action just because its resulting image timed out.

frameId.description: frameId from this MCP session's latest android_screenshot, android_preview_tap, android_control or calibration probe result of this exact phone, less than 30 seconds old.

dx.description: Relative horizontal HID counts for move

dy.description: Relative vertical HID counts for move

text.description: ASCII uses HID. Non-ASCII uses the selected Device Chinese Input IME over encrypted ESP BLE, at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, never NUL. Select the current controller in the phone App, enable and select the device IME once, then focus the target field. Keep it selected for continuous use. No accessibility or clipboard. IME acceptance is not verified insertion; inspect the returned image. Uncertain delivery must not be resubmitted blindly.

x.description: Estimated screenshot X for tap or hover

y.description: Estimated screenshot Y for tap or hover

waitMs.description: Wait before observing, only for wait; default 200 ms

name: android_hid_status
description: Read BLE connection, authentication, physical stop lock, armed state and pointer calibration from the ESP32 bridge.

name: android_hid_arm
description: Explicitly arm authenticated BLE keyboard/mouse input. A physical stop lock must first be cleared on the device controller: select Cancel emergency stop and confirm there. The computer cannot unlock it.

name: android_hid_pause
description: Immediately cancel queued computer input, release all held keys/buttons and disarm. Does not clear the physical stop lock.

name: android_release
description: Cancel queued input and release all held keyboard keys, mouse buttons and consumer keys.

name: android_pointer_calibration
description: Pointer calibration using actual mouse events or visible captured cursor centers. Prefer auto after the user opens Pointer calibration in the phone screen App: it reads fresh actual mouse coordinates from that page and computes both scales with two movements and no click, even when screenshots omit the system cursor. It cannot open the page. probe returns BEFORE/AFTER images; identical images are not measurable and receive no finish ticket. finish uses observed real cursor centers without moving again. No input may intervene. Android acceleration still makes later coordinates estimates.

frameId.description: frameId from this MCP session's latest android_screenshot, android_preview_tap, android_control or calibration probe result of this exact phone, less than 30 seconds old.

counts.description: Probe HID counts on each axis, default 96

startX.description: Cursor center X in the BEFORE image

startY.description: Cursor center Y in the BEFORE image

endX.description: Cursor center X in the AFTER image

endY.description: Cursor center Y in the AFTER image

name: android_calibrate_pointer
description: Set measured HID counts per screenshot pixel. This does not infer mouse acceleration or prove accuracy. Recalibrate after any phone rotation, pointer speed or keyboard/mouse setting change.

frameId.description: frameId from this MCP session's latest android_screenshot, android_preview_tap, android_control or calibration probe result of this exact phone, less than 30 seconds old.

scaleX.description: Horizontal HID counts per screenshot pixel.

scaleY.description: Vertical HID counts per screenshot pixel.

rotation.description: Operator-reported display rotation, 0, 1, 2 or 3. A change invalidates old calibration.

name: android_pointer_home
description: Move the calibrated relative mouse into the top-left corner and reset its estimated position. Requires explicit calibration and armed HID.

frameId.description: frameId from this MCP session's latest android_screenshot, android_preview_tap, android_control or calibration probe result of this exact phone, less than 30 seconds old.

name: android_mouse_move
description: Move the real BLE mouse by relative HID counts. No calibration required. buttons is a held-button bit mask (left=1,right=2,middle=4); always release after a drag.

name: android_mouse_click
description: Click at the mouse's current physical position. Does not move or assume a calibrated location.

name: android_tap
description: Move the calibrated BLE mouse to an estimated screenshot coordinate and click. Uses hardware HID, not ADB input. Accuracy requires real-phone calibration.

frameId.description: frameId from this MCP session's latest android_screenshot, android_preview_tap, android_control or calibration probe result of this exact phone, less than 30 seconds old.

name: android_swipe
description: Drag the calibrated BLE mouse between two screenshot coordinates, then release. The phone must support mouse drag for the target UI.

frameId.description: frameId from this MCP session's latest android_screenshot, android_preview_tap, android_control or calibration probe result of this exact phone, less than 30 seconds old.

durationMs.description: Minimum drag duration, default 400 ms. Report pacing may extend it; result includes plannedDurationMs.

name: android_scroll
description: Send hardware mouse wheel reports. The target device app determines how scrolling is handled.

name: android_type
description: Type into the focused field once. ASCII uses short HID pulses. Non-ASCII uses the user-selected Device Chinese Input IME over encrypted ESP BLE (maximum 512 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL). In the phone App select the current controller, enable and select the device IME once, then focus an editable field. Keep it selected for continuous use; switching away requires selecting it again. No accessibility or clipboard. BEGIN/DATA uploads one transaction; COMMIT submits once and only STATUS is polled while waiting. accepted confirms the InputConnection accepted the text, not target display or saving; insertionVerified stays false. Inspect a new screenshot. Clipboard modes are rejected before uploading text. Cancellation, lost ACK or timeout never replays input: observe first and never blindly resubmit.

text.description: ASCII text/tabs/newlines, or non-ASCII UTF-8 up to 512 bytes via the selected device IME and encrypted ESP BLE. NUL is forbidden. Inspect the target field before any intentional repeat.

name: android_key
description: Press and release a keyboard key or chord, e.g. enter, escape, ctrl+a, shift+tab, meta+h.

name: android_key_report
description: Send a raw standard keyboard report. keycode=0 releases the keyboard; release after a held report.

name: android_consumer_report
description: Send a raw 16-bit consumer HID usage; usage=0 releases it. OEM mappings may differ.

name: android_home
description: Press and release the hardware consumer Home usage. Phone/OEM mapping requires device verification.

name: android_back
description: Press and release the hardware consumer Back usage. Phone/OEM mapping requires device verification.
